quizzes.title: NeoSan Labs Product Training — Knowledge Check

questions.questionText: What kind of registration is the US EPA number on the NeoSan Labs listings?
questions.explanation: Lesson 1.2: CCW states that US EPA Reg. No. 93672 is a United States registration and not an Australian listing.

questions.questionText: How does CCW describe what it sells 02 Air Detox for in Australia?
questions.explanation: Lesson 4.2: CCW states that it sells 02 as an odour treatment only, because it is not on the ARTG.

questions.questionText: What does Part A of each NeoSan Labs product contain?
questions.explanation: Lesson 2.2: the SDS names the Part A substance as a quaternary ammonium compound, CAS 68424-85-1.

questions.questionText: Which CAS number does the SDS give for the Part B substance?
questions.explanation: Lesson 2.3: the SDS names Part B as hydrogen peroxide, CAS 7722-84-1.

questions.questionText: How long does CCW say a mixed batch stays usable?
questions.explanation: Lesson 2.4: after a 10-minute rest, the mixed solution stays usable for 12 hours, so mix only what you will use.

questions.questionText: What does Queensland Health recommend for rooms used by patients with an MRO?
questions.explanation: Lesson 7.1: Queensland Health recommends products with specific MRO claims that are entered on the ARTG.

questions.questionText: What date of document appears on each NeoSan Labs SDS?
questions.explanation: Lesson 3.1: each SDS is dated March 2021 and headed 2021/USA, so record that date in your register.

questions.questionText: For how long does the 01 SDS say to flush an eye?
questions.explanation: Lesson 3.2: section 4 of the SDS says to flush with running water for between 15 and 20 minutes.

questions.questionText: How many times does the 01 SDS say to rinse an empty container?
questions.explanation: Lesson 3.3: section 13 describes a triple rinse, each with the container a quarter full of water.

questions.questionText: What dilution do the 03 directions give for regular cleaning?
questions.explanation: Lesson 4.3: mix A and B in equal parts, then dilute the mix 1:9 with water, or use it full strength on stains.

questions.questionText: What minimum dwell do the 03 directions give before extraction?
questions.explanation: Lesson 4.3: pre-spray, allow at least 2 minutes, then rinse with warm water using an extractor.

questions.questionText: In Australia, what clears a meth-affected property for use?
questions.explanation: Lesson 4.4: CCW states that the property is cleared by post-remediation testing, which the chemistry cannot replace.

questions.questionText: A 25 m² room is dosed at 6.8 ml per square metre. How much mixed product is that?
questions.explanation: Lesson 5.1: 25 × 6.8 = 170 ml of mixed product, which is 85 ml of Part A and 85 ml of Part B.

questions.questionText: How much mixed 03 goes into an 11 L sprayer at 1:9?
questions.explanation: Lesson 5.2: at 1:9 the mixed 03 is one tenth of the finished volume, so 11 L needs 1.1 L.

questions.questionText: Which equipment does CCW say 02 Air Detox needs?
options: A cold fogger or ULV unit
A truck mounted hot water extractor
A compressed air foam system only
questions.explanation: Lesson 6.1: CCW states that a pump-up sprayer will not give the fine, even mist that 02 is designed for.

questions.questionText: Below about how many microns does CCW say a fog behaves like a gas?
questions.explanation: Lesson 6.2: below about 20 microns the fog follows air movement, and above about 50 microns it wets what it lands on.

questions.questionText: Your fogger puts out 35 ml per minute. How long does a 136 ml dose take?
questions.explanation: Lesson 6.3: divide the dose by the output, so 136 ÷ 35 = 3.9 minutes.

questions.questionText: What does an ATP test measure, according to the national IPC guidelines?
questions.explanation: Lesson 7.4: ATP testing measures organic residue, gives rapid results, and cannot identify the source of the ATP.

questions.questionText: In the hierarchy of controls, where does PPE sit?
questions.explanation: Lesson 8.2: work down the hierarchy from removing the hazard, with PPE as the last line of protection.

questions.questionText: What does business.gov.au say an accepted quote becomes?
questions.explanation: Lesson 9.1: an accepted quote becomes a legally binding contract, so describe the work accurately.
